02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.visual_critic_note: Deliberate Paul Tol colorblind-safe palette and KDE diagonal elevate it above generic, but the cramped legend, tiny axis tick labels, and overall lack of visual refinement keep it at competent-functional rather than designed.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.encoding_integrity_note: Honest encoding throughout: data-driven scale domains via d3.extent, proper Silverman's-rule KDE bandwidth, correct zero-baseline for density areas, fixed non-data-encoded dot radius; only minor robustness gap is absent key functions in scatter joins, which is moot for static data.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.stress_test_note: Brush fires full data iteration, ~2400 fill-opacity DOM writes, and KDE recomputation on every mousemove with no RAF coalescing or debounce; xScale/yScaleFlipped captured in static closures with no resize refresh path.
02-linked-scatterplot-matrix.cognitive_load_note: 3-color palette separates cleanly, diagonal KDE panels break grid monotony, 16 cells read as one conceptual unit rather than independent views, and 150px cells are just large enough to resolve point distributions — the SPLOM is well-executed with no unmanaged complexity.
